info.description:
# Introduction
Travelport Trip Services allows developers to quickly build solutions for searching and booking travel across the full range of Travelport supplier content for air, hotel, and car. Trip Services offers developers an off-the-shelf menu of APIs to create efficient, responsive travel applications.

# Overview
Requests are RESTful and can be in either XML or JSON.

# Authentication
Authentication with OAuth 2.0
